childMarkdownRemark.html:
Las Rozas Village APP for iOS devices and Android allows you to navigate through the Village, enjoy exclusive content, style tips, videos and much more.

Plus, sign into your Las Rozas Village Membership account at the click of a button to receive exclusive treats and alerts, as well as all the information you need about pop-ups, luxury services and opening hours.

Download the free APP to discover:

  • Interactive map of the Village: simply touch, pan and zoom maps to view boutiques, search by name or category.

  • Boutique openings, events, live music and entertainment.

  • Where to eat, from our resident restaurants to seasonal pop-ups.

  • Exclusive offers and treats from your favourite boutiques.

  • Guest services: Tax refunds, worldwide courier services, Valet Parking, free Wi-Fi, Village Personal Shopper, play area...

  • Enjoy exclusive Q&A’s, style tips, interviews, videos, behind the scenes footage and much more.
